proof_body:
by
  intro f hc hanti hnn
  have hint : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ t → IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume s t := fun s t hs ht =>
    (hc.mono fun x hx => (le_min hs ht).trans hx.1).intervalIntegrable
  have hsub : ∀ n : ℕ, AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) ((0 : ℝ) + n)) := fun n =>
    hanti.mono fun x hx => hx.1
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hmono : Monotone (fun m : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, f (n : ℝ)) :=
      monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun m => by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        have := hnn m (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
        linarith
    have hle : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, f (n : ℝ) ≤ s := fun m => hmono.ge_of_tendsto hs m
    have hIoi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      refine MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_of_intervalIntegral_norm_bounded s 0
        (fun n : ℕ => (hint 0 n le_rfl (Nat.cast_nonneg n)).1) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
      have h1 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(n : ℝ), ‖f x‖ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(n : ℝ), f x := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx => ?_
        have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (Nat.cast_nonneg n)] at hx
          exact hx.1
        exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (hnn x hx0)
      have h2 := (hsub n).integral_le_sum
      simp only [zero_add] at h2
      rw [h1]
      exact h2.trans (hle n)
    exact ⟨_, MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi 0 hIoi Filter.tendsto_id⟩
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    have hseq : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(n : ℝ), f x) Filter.atTop (nhds L) :=
      hL.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have hmono : Monotone (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(n : ℝ), f x) :=
      monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => by
        have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
        have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        have e := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hint 0 n le_rfl h0) (hint n ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) h0 h1)
        have p : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (n : ℝ)..((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ), f x :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by push_cast; linarith) fun u hu => hnn u (h0.trans hu.1)
        linarith
    have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(n : ℝ), f x ≤ L := fun n => hmono.ge_of_tendsto hseq n
    have hb : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, f (n : ℝ) ≤ f 0 + L := by
      intro m
      have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by
        have := hle 0
        simpa using this
      have hf0 := hnn 0 le_rfl
      cases m with
      | zero => simp; linarith
      | succ m =>
        have h2 := (hsub m).sum_le_integral
        simp only [zero_add] at h2
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
        have h3 := hle m
        simp only [Nat.cast_zero]
        linarith
    exact ⟨_, (summable_of_sum_range_le (fun n => hnn n (Nat.cast_nonneg n)) hb).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat⟩
target_source: ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici 0) → AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 0) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) → ((∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, f (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ↔ ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..t, f x) Filter.atTop (nhds L))
